input.description: Deterministic synthetic unlabeled two-channel-slot recording; no dataset labels supplied.

method.name: Joint Integrated Gradients with Gauss-Legendre quadrature
method.baseline: Zero-valued normalized raw EEG and handcrafted features; this corresponds to the saved training normalization means. Attributions explain the model inputs after preprocessing and do not attribute the filtering operation.

interpretation_note: Probabilities are model outputs and are not calibrated confidence estimates; attribution values are not confidence, causation, or diagnostic evidence.
limitations: Attributions describe model-input contribution, not causation, diagnostic evidence, or model confidence.
Attribution starts after preprocessing and does not explain the Butterworth filtering operation.
Raw channels are unverified channel slots; no electrode identities are asserted.
This synthetic smoke test does not establish subject-independent or clinical performance.
